questions.question: One of the eigen vectors of the matrix A = [latex]\begin{bmatrix} 2 & 2\\ 1 & 3 \end{bmatrix}[/latex] is
questions.explanation: [latex]A=\left[\begin{array}{ll}2 & 2 \\1 & 3\end{array}\right][/latex] Characteristic equation of A is [latex]\begin{aligned}\left|\begin{array}{cc}2-\lambda & 2 \\1 & 3-\lambda\end{array}\right| &=0 \\(2-\lambda)(3-\lambda)-2 &=0 \\ \lambda^{2}-5 \lambda+4 &=0 \\\lambda &=1,4\end{aligned}[/latex] The eigen value problem is [latex] [A-\lambda ] \hat{x}=0 [/latex] [latex] \left[\begin{array}{cc}2-\lambda & 2 \\ 1 & 3-\lambda\end{array}\right]\left[\begin{array}{l}x_{1} \\ _{2}\end{array}\right]=\left[\begin{array}{l}0 \\ 0\end{array}\right][/latex] [latex] \text{Putting} \quad \lambda=1 [/latex] [latex] \begin{aligned}\left[\begin{array}{ll}1 & 2 \\1 & 2\end{array}\right]\left[\begin{array}{l}x_{1} \\x_{2} \end{array}\right] &=\left[\begin{array}{l}0 \\0\end{array}\right] \\ x_{1}+2 x_{2} &=0 \\ x_{1}+2 x_{2} &=0 \end{aligned}[/latex] [latex] \text{Solution is } x_{2}=k, x_{1}=-2 k [/latex] [latex] \hat{x}_{1}=\left[\begin{array}{r} -2 k \\k\end{array}\right]\\ i.e. x_{1}: x_{2}=-2: 1\\ \text{since, choice (A)} \left[\begin{array}{c}2 \\ -1\end{array}\right] [/latex]is in same ratio of [latex] x_{1} \text{ to } x_{2} [/latex] [latex] \therefore[/latex] Choice (A) is an eigen vector.
questions.explanation_html:
[latex]A=\left[\begin{array}{ll}2 & 2 \\1 & 3\end{array}\right][/latex]
Characteristic equation of A is
[latex]\begin{aligned}\left|\begin{array}{cc}2-\lambda & 2 \\1 & 3-\lambda\end{array}\right| &=0 \\(2-\lambda)(3-\lambda)-2 &=0 \\ \lambda^{2}-5 \lambda+4 &=0 \\\lambda &=1,4\end{aligned}[/latex]
The eigen value problem is [latex] [A-\lambda ] \hat{x}=0 [/latex]
[latex] \left[\begin{array}{cc}2-\lambda & 2 \\ 1 & 3-\lambda\end{array}\right]\left[\begin{array}{l}x_{1} \\ _{2}\end{array}\right]=\left[\begin{array}{l}0 \\ 0\end{array}\right][/latex]
[latex] \text{Putting} \quad \lambda=1 [/latex]
[latex] \begin{aligned}\left[\begin{array}{ll}1 & 2 \\1 & 2\end{array}\right]\left[\begin{array}{l}x_{1} \\x_{2} \end{array}\right] &=\left[\begin{array}{l}0 \\0\end{array}\right] \\ x_{1}+2 x_{2} &=0 \\ x_{1}+2 x_{2} &=0 \end{aligned}[/latex]
[latex] \text{Solution is } x_{2}=k, x_{1}=-2 k [/latex]
[latex] \hat{x}_{1}=\left[\begin{array}{r} -2 k \\k\end{array}\right]\\ i.e. x_{1}: x_{2}=-2: 1\\ \text{since, choice (A)} \left[\begin{array}{c}2 \\ -1\end{array}\right] [/latex]is in same ratio of [latex] x_{1} \text{ to } x_{2} [/latex]
[latex] \therefore[/latex] Choice (A) is an eigen vector.

It can be used for two or more variables as well (always advisable for more than two variables to avoid lengthy graphical procedure).
